##### Project general facts

Umalas Private Suite is a modern boutique residential project, designed as a compact and functional living space tailored for both personal use and short-term rental. The concept of the project focuses on creating a private, comfortable environment with a contemporary architectural style, where clean lines, natural light, and efficient layouts form a harmonious space. Positioned as an Airbnb-ready investment, the project combines aesthetics with practicality, offering a turnkey solution for immediate operation.

The project provides a well-thought-out infrastructure that supports both lifestyle and rental demand. Each unit includes outdoor areas with landscaping, lounge spaces, and lighting elements that create a cozy atmosphere for relaxation. The overall environment is designed to ensure privacy and convenience, while maintaining a modern and attractive look for guests. Air conditioning systems, quality lighting, and carefully planned common and private zones enhance the everyday living experience and increase the property’s rental appeal.

The residences are fully furnished and equipped according to Airbnb-ready standards, offering a complete turnkey solution. Each unit features a fully equipped kitchen with appliances including a stove, refrigerator, dispenser, and full set of kitchen utensils (plates, glasses, cookware, and accessories). Living spaces include dining areas, sofas, and lighting fixtures, while bedrooms are fitted with bed frames, mattresses, wardrobes, linens, and decor elements. Bathrooms are fully completed with sanitary equipment, storage, and accessories. Additional features such as outdoor furniture, decorative elements, and functional storage solutions ensure that every unit is ready for immediate living or rental, combining comfort, practicality, and modern design.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Umalas is a highly sought-after residential area known for its tranquility and green atmosphere, strategically located between the vibrant hubs of Canggu and Seminyak. This unique positioning allows residents to enjoy privacy and tranquility while remaining just minutes away from Bali’s best beach clubs, restaurants, and lifestyle destinations. Umalas is especially popular among expats and long-term residents who value a more relaxed environment without sacrificing accessibility.

The area is characterized by low-density development, rice field views, and a well-balanced mix of modern villas and boutique residences. Unlike the busier neighboring districts, Umalas offers wider streets, less traffic, and a more residential feel, making it ideal for families and those seeking a comfortable everyday lifestyle. At the same time, it provides easy access to international schools, fitness centers, cafés, and essential infrastructure, supporting both living and long-term stays.

Umalas continues to grow in popularity due to its strong rental demand and limited supply of quality real estate. Its central location, combined with a peaceful setting, makes it one of the most attractive areas for both living and investment in Bali. As development expands and surrounding districts become more saturated, Umalas stands out as a balanced and promising location offering long-term value and a high quality of life.
